kn_2011_09_08.publisher: Kaieteur News (Guyana), citing a Guyana Police Force crime statistics release
kn_2011_09_08.licence: no licence stated (news article; only short quotes kept in raw/quotes.txt)
kn_2011_09_08.years: 1 Jan-31 Aug 2011 (and A Division domestic murders for the same period of 2010)
kn_2011_09_08.notes: Last-resort route (police figures quoted in news). Text read via WebFetch because the shell got HTTP 429; exact sentences in raw/quotes.txt. Division counts are given only for three murder types (execution, disorderly, domestic), and only partly for domestic murders; no all-murder total by division. Execution and disorderly division counts add up to the national totals printed in the same article (5 and 31). Division names in parentheses are the usual GPF areas, added for readability; the article itself gives only the letters (and "hinterland" for E and F). Police divisions have no open boundary file; shapes left empty.

problems: The Guyana Police Force website (guyanapoliceforce.gy) has no crime statistics downloads; murder figures by police division (A-G) appear only in press releases and news reports, not as an official open file. No other official source found. Retry (17 Oct): (1) Guyana Police Force Annual Report 2014 (policinglaw.info copy, read via WebFetch; the shell connection was reset) gives total murder reports only (155 in 2013, 149 in 2014); its only per-division murder row counts crime scenes processed by the Fingerprint Branch, not murders, so not used. (2) Bureau of Statistics "Yearly and Quarterly Deaths by Region and by Sex 2009-2025" has all-cause deaths only, no cause of death. (3) Parliament "Documents Laid" listings searched for later GPF annual reports; none found online with division tables. (4) Division figures exist only in press reports quoting police (e.g. Kaieteur News 2011), which are not an official file. THIRD PASS 17 Oct: searched news for police-cited division figures (Kaieteur News, Stabroek News, Guyana Times, News Room, HGPTV, DPI). Most year-end police briefings (2019, 2023, 2024, 2025) give national murder totals only. Found one 2011 police release with division counts for three murder types and one 2014 briefing with two division shares; used. A Stabroek News 2010 division tally was not used because it is not attributed to a named police source (see raw/quotes.txt).
